[Anne](/person/1582) and I were pleased to have a sight of [Emily](/person/81); there is more change in the latter than in the former in the fourteen years since they met.[^1] I hope [you](/person/1019) will not have to part with the Chester division[^2] of the family much before Christmas.

Perhaps if you do not join them there very soon after they go, you would let me come to you for a little while. . . I am not afraid of solitary days; after all, it is all well . . .


[^1]: Anne Yonge (b. 1825) would have been 29 fourteen years earlier, Emily Awdry (nee Moberly) (b. 1839) only 15.
[^2]: Dr Moberly was appointed a Canon of Chester in October 1868, and the family moved there in December 1868.
